{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yang Fire Tiger''' (丙寅, ''hinoe tora''; onyomi ''heiin'') is the 3rd of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|af|Sestigdelige siklus|ar|دورة ستينية|arz|دوره ستينيه|as|ষাঠি বছৰীয়া আৱৰ্তন|ast|Ciclu sexaxenariu|bn|ষাটবার্ষিক চক্র|ca|Cicle sexagesimal|cdo|Găng-ciĕ|cs|Kan-č’|de|60-Jahre-Zyklus|eo|Ĉina sesdekjara ciklo|es|Ciclo sexagesimal chino|eu|Hirurogeitaka urteko ziklo|fa|چرخه شصت‌تایی|fr|Cycle sexagésimal chinois|hak|Kôn-chṳ̂|hy|Վաթսունամյա շրջան|id|Ganzhi|it|Ganzhi|ja|干支|ka|სამოცეული ციკლი|ko|간지|mk|Шеесетгодишен циклус|ms|Ganzhi|nn|Sekstiårig syklus|no|Sekstiårig syklus|ru|Система гань-чжи|sh|Seksagenarni ciklus|simple|Sexagenary cycle|su|Daur séksagenari|sv|Himmelska stammar och jordiska grenar|th|แผนภูมิสวรรค์|tr|Altmışlık döngü|uk|Шістдесятирічний цикл|vi|Can Chi|wuu|干支|xmf|გან-ჩჟიშ სისტემა|za|Gancei|zh|干支|zh_classical|干支|zh_min_nan|Kan-chi|zh_yue|干支|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 3rd of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Wood Ox|ja|乙丑}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Fire Rabbit|ja|丁卯}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''丙'' is Yang Fire, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''寅'' (Tiger) is Yang Wood; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Fire Tiger (丙寅)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): bǐngyín
** Cantonese (Jyutping): bing3 jan4
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: hinoe-tora
*** On'yomi: heiin
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): byeongin (병인)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Bính Dần

==Months of Yang Fire Tiger==
The first month (January) of a year ending in 4 or 9 in the Western calendar (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=stem}} is [[:en:甲|Kō]] or [[:en:己|Ki]]) is designated as a Heiin month. However, this is based on the [[:en:Chinese lunar calendar|lunar calendar]] or the [[solar term calendar]], where the month may start from [[:en:Lìchūn|Risshun]] to the day before {{ill|Jingzhe|af|Jingzhe|cdo|Gĭng-dĭk|fr|Jingzhe|hak|Kiang-chhít|id|Jingzhe|ja|啓蟄|ko|경칩|sv|Jingzhe|vi|Kinh trập|za|Gingcig|zh|惊蛰|zh_classical|驚蟄|zh_min_nan|Keⁿ-ti̍t|zh_yue|驚蟄|qid=Q1306596|lt=Keichitsu}}.
